name: Knight-Lord Bloodvalor
summary: Knight-Lord Bloodvalor is a prominent officer within the newly formed Blood Knights in Silvermoon City. Tasked with molding the order's fledgling paladins, he oversees the rigorous and unorthodox trials required to master their seized holy power.

sections.title: Master of Trials
sections.body: Following the founding of the Blood Knights in 25 ADP, Knight-Lord Bloodvalor took up an essential role within the Hall of Blood. Rather than seeking harmony through traditional devotion, the order bends the Holy Light to its will, demanding ruthless discipline and unshakable resolve from its initiates. Bloodvalor serves as an unyielding instructor, directly managing rank-and-file recruits and evaluating them through their early trials to ensure they are fit to bear the mantle of the sin'dorei.

sections.title: Service to the Sin'dorei
sections.body: Beyond testing raw combat prowess, Bloodvalor ensures that initiates comprehend the order's grim pragmatism. When guiding novitiates through lethal tests of martial prowess and subsequent resurrection rites, his instructions leave no room for hesitation or sentimentality. In the field, he has led blood knight forces against regional threats at Sunsail Anchorage and Dawnstar Spire, proving that his rank was won through battle.

faq.answer: He is an officer of the Blood Knights stationed within the Hall of Blood in Silvermoon City. He oversees the early development and trial rites of new blood elf paladins.

faq.q: What does Bloodvalor do for blood elf paladins?
faq.answer: Bloodvalor assigns initiates their critical training trials, testing their martial discipline, their handling of the captured Light, and their readiness to advance through the ranks of the Blood Knights.

faq.q: Where can Knight-Lord Bloodvalor be found?
faq.answer: He is stationed inside the Hall of Blood, the military headquarters of the Blood Knights situated in Silvermoon City.

faq.q: How does he view the Holy Light?
faq.answer: Like the rest of the Blood Knights, Bloodvalor does not worship or pray to the Light. He views it as a force to be commanded and claimed through strength of will in service to Quel'Thalas.

angles.text: For blood elf paladins, Bloodvalor is the stern face of authority who judges whether an initiate is worthy to rise above the rank of novice in the Blood Knights.
Bloodvalor embodies the disciplined military might of the sin'dorei, training warriors capable of defending Silvermoon and securing Horde interests.
